decisions.reason: As a visible homepage product line close to the firm's core handcrafted candle-arch business, it reflects clear public commitment and enough invested effort that management would almost certainly continue it and attribute any early weakness to seasonal factors.
This one-tier Christmas pyramid fits the established offer well and was featured prominently, so management is likely to persist with it rather than reverse course after only one season.

Although the electronic music box is more distant from the traditional range, the firm has visibly backed it on the home page with several models, which makes management inclined to justify and continue the investment.

This accessory is less prominently committed than the main products, but because it supports the electronic music box platform that the firm has already introduced, management would still be somewhat reluctant to withdraw it quickly.

The Christmas motif platform is a narrower and less visible add-on, so it is more exposed to pruning, yet management can still frame any disappointing uptake as temporary seasonality and keep it alongside the music-box range.
A Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm's traditional strengths and was shown on the home page, so management is likely to retain it as a committed extension of the core line.
